Provide one operator music folder with one immediate subfolder per block, accepting chill.ogg, tension2.ogg, tension3.ogg, tension4.ogg, boss.ogg and fanfare.ogg. Accept tension1/attention1 and attention2/3/4 aliases without ambiguous duplicate roles. A direct folder scan or bounded safe ZIP import generates manifests, immutable versions, compact section cues and delivery chunks before publishing one complete catalog. Ordinary imports reuse unchanged prepared blocks; an explicit offline rebuild regenerates analyzed cues while retaining auditioned authored overrides. Cue rebuilding affects future plans only. No waveform analysis, directory scans or cue generation occurs during game startup or gameplay. Invalid or interrupted preparation preserves the prior catalog and mirrored game registration. Retain all immutable media needed by existing plans.
Use the existing Vorbis stereo 44.1 kHz contract and per-file duration/size limits. Offline grid inference may select a complete-bar grid from rhythmic evidence; accept optional per-block tempo and authored-cue metadata for ambiguous recordings, and reject unsuitable pulse/quiet content instead of fabricating it. Preserve matching custom tension transports. Provide precise ZIP layout, format guidance, VPS preparation/import/rebuild commands, hosting prerequisites and a finite test of first-block fallback, cue readiness, safe archives, idempotent reimport, atomic failure and frozen runtime plans. The batch ZIP may contain up to 1 GiB expanded data and 256 blocks; process one recording at a time. These are ingestion limits, not additional gameplay resource allowances.
